caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair with a tall backrest and elaborately carved top rail with scrollwork detail. The chair has four vertical slats forming the backrest, each shaped with spindle-like turning. The rear legs extend upward to form the backrest posts, capped with small round finials. The legs and stretchers of the chair are also turned, with the front legs ending in rounded feet and displaying ornamentation. The seat of the chair is made of woven material, depicted in a light tan or beige color contrasting with the reddish-brown hue used for the wooden parts. The chair is set at a slight angle, facing toward the right and positioned against a plain, light background within a rectangular border. A signature or name, "Gussow," is present in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Side Chair
